story-context.title: Capability Catalog Cutover
story-context.overview: Single authoritative component catalog via resolve_allowed_components(company_id, country_id), consumed by form-builder init (toolbox), Form AI Blocks A/F/I, and the semantic validator. Migrate Block F into the Prompt Assembly Registry as a GENERATED section. Replace brandPosture enum path with ref.BrandPosture for Block C variant selection. Highest-risk story in the 6.5 decomposition — alignment bugs surface as "AI invented a type not in the toolbox."

critical-objectives.item: One resolver implementation; get_allowed_components delegates to it.
Form AI stops using ComponentCapabilitySnapshot for allowed-type lists.
Block F in registry with DynamicComponentCatalog hydration at render time.
Blocks A/I contract fragments list same componentType codes as Block F.
Frontend toolbox palette built only from POST /api/form-builder/init components[].
ref.BrandPosture seeded; Block C variant selection uses ref codes.
AC-15 catalog alignment proof: toolbox = prompt = validator for AU fixture.

constraints.item: Do NOT run Alembic. Migrations start at 084_.
Do NOT implement Block E / clarification dropdowns (6.5d).
Do NOT break 6.5b registry paths for Blocks A/B/C/G/I prose.

path.note: get_allowed_components, build_init_payload — refactor to catalog resolver.
Toolbox must consume init components only (discover exact files during implementation).
